text: 🚨🇲🇽 UN human rights chief presses the US for prompt investigations into Mexican deaths in ICE custody. "He called on US authorities to carry out prompt investigations, to guarantee the human rights of the victims, and for there to be justice." — Roberto Velasco, Foreign Secretary Volker Türk, the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, responded to Mexico's letter, forwarded the case to the UN Human Rights Council and said he will keep monitoring US detention centers.

text: 🚨🇲🇽 "17 Mexicans have lost their lives in ICE operations or custody." Mexico has filed 20 criminal complaints with state and district prosecutors in the 8 states where the deaths occurred. — Roberto Velasco, Foreign Secretary The deaths occurred in Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Missouri and Texas. Mexico also filed a complaint with the US Department of Justice and raised the cases directly with DHS, ICE and Ambassador Ron Johnson.

🇲🇽📈 <u>S&P: MEXICO'S BIG BANKS SOLID DESPITE CHALLENGING OUTLOOK</u>

Mexico's main banks have solid fundamentals to navigate a challenging panorama of moderate growth, external uncertainty and structural hurdles, an S&P National Ratings analysis found — credit from the country's principal banks will grow between 6 and 8 percent this year, El Financiero reports. Even with the economy expected to advance just 1.0 percent in 2026, the banking system holds firm.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>TEXAN CONVICTED OF TRAFFICKING PARTS FOR 5,000 RIFLES TO MEXICO</u>

A US federal jury convicted Chandler Britain Bradford for trafficking enough components to assemble more than 5,000 semiautomatic rifles into Mexico, with illicit gains topping $3.5 million, Regeneración reports. Federal prosecutor Justin R. Simmons said the defendant “knew that the weapons would end up in the hands of drug trafficking organizations.”

🔥🇲🇽 <u>THE DFS SPIED ON JULIO SCHERER FOR 20 YEARS</u>

Mexico's Federal Security Directorate tailed journalist Julio Scherer for nearly two decades. The files at the National General Archive — consulted by Contralínea — start in 1959 and intensify under Echeverría, tracking his personal life, political meetings and the inner life of the Excélsior cooperative until his expulsion in July 1976, in the thick of the Dirty War. The same archive the 4T finally opened to the public.
banner: DFS SPIED ON SCHERER FOR 20 YEARS

🇲🇽⚖️ <u>CNDH DOCUMENTS STATE TERROR IN MEXICO'S DIRTY WAR</u>

Mexico's National Human Rights Commission presented recommendations 46/2022 and 98VG/2023 documenting how military-police networks repressed left-wing dissidents between 1951 and 1990. CNDH president Rosario Piedra Ibarra said the victims of that state political violence are still unquantifiable today. Truth first, then justice — the archive is finally being opened.
banner: DIRTY WAR: CNDH CONFIRMS STATE TERROR

🇲🇽🧮 <u>MEXICAN MATHEMATICIAN CLOSES IN ON RIEMANN HYPOTHESIS</u>

José Damián Espinosa developed a new approach to the Riemann hypothesis — one of the six Millennium Problems still unsolved — with an equivalent reformulation published as a preprint on Zenodo, La Jornada reports. The work advances the prime number theorem. The hypothesis has stood unsolved since 1859; a Mexican mind is now knocking on its door.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>ARMY CAPTURES FOUR CJNG BOSSES IN MICHOACÁN</u>

Mexican Army personnel captured four CJNG cell leaders in Zamora, Michoacán, in direct actions against groups dedicated to drug production and trafficking, La Jornada reports. Federal forces reinforced operations to clear highway blockades across the state — Mexico doing the work on its own soil, with its own forces.
